map.机密文件（.env）务必忽略；但 .gitignore 不是安全边界，敏感信息请: Always ignore secret files such as .env; but .gitignore is not a security boundary, so never commit sensitive information in the first place.

map.规则不生效怎么排查？: How do I debug rules that do not take effect?
map.先看该文件是否已被 Git 跟踪（.gitignore 只对未跟踪文件有效，需先: First check whether the file is already tracked (the .gitignore only affects untracked files, so run git rm --cached first). Then check how the rule is written — directories need a trailing slash, negation uses !, and ** matches across levels; later rules override earlier ones with the same pattern, so mind the order. Use git check-ignore -v to see which rule matched.
